items.title: Pay ergotherapy invoice
items.quote: Bitte überweisen Sie den Betrag binnen 21 Tagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum.
items.computation: Period starts from the invoice date 18.11.2026 (Rechnungsdatum). Under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 1 BGB, the day of the event (18.11.2026) is not counted; the 21-day period begins on 19.11.2026 and ends 21 days later, i.e. on 09.12.2026 (18.11 + 21 days = 09.12.2026). This is a private payment obligation to a company based in NW (payer's own Land also NW), so NW holidays apply for any weekend/holiday shift. 09.12.2026 is a Wednesday (verified: 25.12.2026 is a Friday; counting back in 7-day steps gives 09.12.2026 = Wednesday), not a weekend or public holiday, so no shift under § 193 BGB is needed.
